# Solos Gems

> Independent, scored reviews of AI tools for solopreneurs, plus a categorized directory of 175+ AI tools across every major category. The homepage (https://solosgems.com/) is the full AI tools database, browsable by category. The 43 tools Solos Gems has fully tested get a priced, scored review and a rank on a single cross-category list (0-10, weighted across value for price, real-world capability, ease of use, and trial safety), listed at https://solosgems.com/reviews.html, not a per-category leaderboard. Nothing scores a 10. Reviews cover what a tool actually does, what it costs once the free tier runs out, and who it's a bad fit for. Some links are affiliate links (disclosed on the About page); that never changes which tools are covered or what the verdict says.

Last updated: 2026-08-04.

## Reviews (ranked #1-43, current as of last update, full list at https://solosgems.com/reviews.html)

- [Canva Magic Studio](https://solosgems.com/reviews/canva-magic-studio.html): #1, 8.7/10. AI design tools (background removal, resizing, on-brand generation) bundled into Canva Pro.
- [NotebookLM](https://solosgems.com/reviews/notebooklm.html): #2, 8.6/10. Google's source-grounded AI notebook; free tier covers 100 notebooks and 50 chats a day. Best Free Tier.
- [Fireflies.ai](https://solosgems.com/reviews/fireflies-ai.html): #3, 8.4/10. Meeting transcription with unlimited minutes on every tier, including free. Best Value.
- [Beehiiv](https://solosgems.com/reviews/beehiiv.html): #4, 8.2/10. Newsletter platform built for monetization from day one; 0% commission on paid subscriptions. Safest Free Trial.
- [Grammarly](https://solosgems.com/reviews/grammarly.html): #5, 8.1/10. Grammar, tone, and clarity checking everywhere you write; annual Pro billing is far cheaper than monthly.
- [Otter.ai](https://solosgems.com/reviews/otter-ai.html): #6, 8.0/10. Real-time meeting transcription and summaries; Business tier bills a 5-seat minimum.
- [Photoroom](https://solosgems.com/reviews/photoroom.html): #7, 7.9/10. AI background removal and product photo editing for solo sellers, from $7.50/month billed yearly.
- [Descript](https://solosgems.com/reviews/descript.html): #8, 7.8/10. Edit audio/video by editing a text transcript. Most Powerful.
- [Koala AI](https://solosgems.com/reviews/koala-ai.html): #9, 7.7/10. AI writer built for SEO-optimized articles, from $9/month.
- [Airtable](https://solosgems.com/reviews/airtable.html): #10, 7.6/10. Spreadsheet-database hybrid with AI credits; free plan covers most solo use cases outright.
- [Wispr Flow](https://solosgems.com/reviews/wispr-flow.html): #11, 7.55/10. Voice dictation that turns speech into clean writing in any app, free up to 2,000 words/week or $12/user/month for unlimited.
- [ClickUp Brain](https://solosgems.com/reviews/clickup-ai.html): #12, 7.5/10. AI layer on ClickUp's project management platform, sold as a paid add-on.
- [Toggl Track](https://solosgems.com/reviews/toggl-track.html): #13, 7.4/10. Time tracking with AI-assisted categorization; free for up to 5 users.
- [Calendly](https://solosgems.com/reviews/calendly.html): #14, 7.3/10. Scheduling with AI-assisted call routing and no-show reduction. Easiest Start.
- [Bonsai](https://solosgems.com/reviews/bonsai.html): #15, 7.2/10. Contracts, invoicing, and scheduling for freelancers; Essentials tier is the sweet spot.
- [HubSpot Free CRM](https://solosgems.com/reviews/hubspot-free-crm.html): #16, 7.1/10. Free CRM tier is genuinely solid; AI features (Breeze) are rate-limited or paid.
- [Loom](https://solosgems.com/reviews/loom.html): #17, 7.0/10. Async video messaging with AI transcripts and summaries; free tier caps videos at 5 minutes.
- [Numerous.ai](https://solosgems.com/reviews/numerous-ai.html): #18, 6.95/10. AI formula that runs a plain-language instruction inside Google Sheets and Excel, from $8/month billed yearly.
- [Gamma](https://solosgems.com/reviews/gamma.html): #19, 6.9/10. Turns a prompt into a formatted slide deck, document, or webpage.
- [Make](https://solosgems.com/reviews/make.html): #20, 6.8/10. Visual automation platform and a direct alternative to Zapier; credit-based pricing.
- [Midjourney](https://solosgems.com/reviews/midjourney.html): #21, 6.7/10. Distinctive AI image generation; no free plan.
- [Shortwave](https://solosgems.com/reviews/shortwave.html): #22, 6.6/10. AI email client that triages and summarizes your inbox; $18/seat/month for Pro.
- [Copy.ai vs. Jasper](https://solosgems.com/reviews/copyai-vs-jasper.html): #23, 6.5/10. Head-to-head AI copywriting comparison for solo operators.
- [Framer](https://solosgems.com/reviews/framer.html): #24, 6.4/10. AI-assisted website builder; generate and publish a real site from a prompt, then edit visually.
- [Zapier AI Actions](https://solosgems.com/reviews/zapier-ai.html): #25, 6.3/10. AI decision-making steps inside Zapier automations; new pricing model is easy to overspend on.
- [Riverside.fm](https://solosgems.com/reviews/riverside.html): #26, 6.2/10. Studio-quality remote podcast and video recording with local-device recording.
- [Suno](https://solosgems.com/reviews/suno.html): #27, 6.15/10. AI music generation from a text prompt, full songs with vocals, free or from $8/month billed yearly for commercial use.
- [ElevenLabs](https://solosgems.com/reviews/elevenlabs.html): #28, 6.1/10. AI voice generation and cloning; free tier is watermarked and non-commercial.
- [Chatbase](https://solosgems.com/reviews/chatbase.html): #29, 6.0/10. Custom AI chatbot trained on your own site or docs, from $32/month.
- [Cursor](https://solosgems.com/reviews/cursor.html): #30, 5.9/10. AI-native code editor for solopreneurs building their own product.
- [QuickBooks Solopreneur](https://solosgems.com/reviews/quickbooks-solopreneur.html): #31, 5.8/10. Bookkeeping built for one-person Schedule-C businesses, not a scaled-down QuickBooks Online.
- [OpusClip](https://solosgems.com/reviews/opusclip.html): #32, 5.7/10. Turns long-form video into short social clips automatically, from $15/month.
- [v0](https://solosgems.com/reviews/vercel-v0.html): #33, 5.65/10. Generates real, working frontend UI code from a prompt, free or from $30/user/month.
- [Runway](https://solosgems.com/reviews/runway.html): #34, 5.6/10. AI video generation and editing for solo creators, from $15/month.
- [Notion AI](https://solosgems.com/reviews/notion-ai.html): #35, 5.5/10. Notion's AI layer now requires the $20/user/month Business plan.
- [Motion](https://solosgems.com/reviews/motion.html): #36, 5.4/10. AI calendar that auto-schedules your tasks around meetings; no free plan.
- [Typeform](https://solosgems.com/reviews/typeform.html): #37, 5.3/10. Conversational forms and surveys with AI-assisted question generation, from $28/month.
- [Semrush](https://solosgems.com/reviews/semrush.html): #38, 5.2/10. SEO research with AI-assisted content and keyword tools, from $139.95/month.
- [Apollo.io](https://solosgems.com/reviews/apollo-io.html): #39, 5.1/10. AI-assisted lead sourcing and outreach sequencing, from $49/user/month.
- [Perplexity Pro](https://solosgems.com/reviews/perplexity-pro.html): #40, 5.0/10. Cited, sourced AI search; a nice-to-have if you already pay for another AI assistant.
- [Synthesia](https://solosgems.com/reviews/synthesia.html): #41, 4.9/10. Turns a script into a talking-avatar video, from $14/month.
- [Bland AI](https://solosgems.com/reviews/bland-ai.html): #42, 4.8/10. Programmable AI voice agents billed per minute, from $0.14/min.
- [Lovable](https://solosgems.com/reviews/lovable.html): #43, 4.7/10. Describe an app in plain English and get a working frontend and backend, from $25/month.
